#Voter Turnout
```{r}

us_vot <- get_chrr_measure_data(
  geography = "county",
  measure = 177,
  release_year = 2024)

us_vot <- us_vot |> subset(select = -c(numerator,denominator,ci_low,ci_high))

us_vot$fips <- paste(us_vot$state_fips,us_vot$county_fips)

us_vot_avg <- data.frame(
  fips = c("00000"),
  raw_value = c(mean(us_vot$raw_value, na.rm = TRUE)))

ne_vot <- get_chrr_measure_data(
  geography = "state",
  measure = 177,
  release_year = 2024
) |> filter(state_fips %in%  c("25", "09", "23", "33", "50", "44")
            )|> subset(select = -c(numerator,denominator,ci_low,ci_high))

ne_vot_avg <- data.frame(
  fips = c("ne"),
  raw_value = c(mean(ne_vot$raw_value, na.rm = TRUE)))

county_vot <- get_chrr_measure_data(
  geography = "county",
  measure = 177,
  release_year = 2024
) |> filter(state_fips == "25") |> subset(
  select = -c(numerator,denominator,ci_low,ci_high))

ne_vot$fips <- paste(ne_vot$state_fips,ne_vot$county_fips)
county_vot$fips <- paste(county_vot$state_fips,county_vot$county_fips)

scalar_vot <- bind_rows(county_vot, ne_vot, us_vot_avg, ne_vot_avg)

scalar_vot$fips <- stringr::str_replace_all(scalar_vot$fips, "\\s+", "")

scalar_vot$state_fips <- NULL
scalar_vot$county_fips <- NULL

#fips of 00000 = USA all

```

#Registration Rate
```{r}
eavs <- read_csv('ec data/2024eavs.csv') |> subset(select = c(FIPSCode,State_Abbr,A1a))
#eavs <- convert_fips_to_names(c(eavs$FIPSCode), states = c(eavs$State_Abbr), geo_header = "COUNTY")

eavs <- eavs %>%
              separate(FIPSCode, into = c("FIPS_code", "Subdiv"), sep = 5)

eavs_c <- summarise(eavs, regs = sum(A1a), .by = FIPS_code)

eavs <- merge(eavs, eavs_c, by = 'FIPS_code')

popn <- read_csv('ec data/LiteracyRates - County.csv') |> subset.data.frame(select = c(grpName,FIPS_code, POP, County), na.rm = TRUE) |> filter(grpName %in%  c('all')) 
popn$grpName <- NULL 


rr <- merge(eavs_c, popn, by = "FIPS_code")

rr$rr <- (rr$reg / rr$POP)
rr <- rr %>% rename_at('FIPS_code', ~'Geo')
rr <- rr %>%
              separate(Geo, into = c("State", "County"), sep = 2, remove = FALSE)
#eavs <- convert_fips_to_names(c(eavs$FIPSCode), states = c(eavs$State_Abbr), geo_header = "COUNTY")
rr$rr <- as.numeric(rr$rr)

ne_rr <- rr |> filter(State %in%  c("25", "9", "23", "33", "50", "44"))

ne_rr <- summarise(ne_rr, rr_avg = mean(rr), .by = State)
ne_rr$State <- convert_fips_to_names(c("25", "09", "23", "33", "50", "44"), geo_header = "STATE")

county_rr <- rr |> filter(State %in%  c("25")) |> filter(County %in%  c("001", "003", "005", "007", "009", "011", "013","015","017","019","021","023","025","027"))
county_rr$County <- convert_fips_to_names(c("001", "003", "005", "007", "009", "011", "013","015","017","019","021","023","025","027"), states = c("MA"), geo_header = "COUNTY")
county_rr$State <- NULL
county_rr <- county_rr %>% rename_at('Geo', ~'FIPS_code')
county_rr <- county_rr %>% rename_at('County', ~'Geo')
county_rr$regs <- NULL
county_rr$POP <- NULL



scalar_rr <- data.frame(
  Geo = c('United States',)
  rr = c(mean(rr$rr, na.rm = TRUE))
)




#Dr. C, I need to combine census and eavs df by fips - they are both at county level, but census has geoID and eavs is county fips with leading 0s. 
#After that, I need to calculate registration rate from each county (eavs A1a = registrants, census S2901 value = estimated total eligible voters in the county; would need to divide A1a/S2901) and then aggregate averages by all (US avg), among NE states (NE avg), among MA (MA avg) and then separate out MA counties



```

#Data Tidying Figure 2

#Social Associations
```{r}

us_soc <- get_chrr_measure_data(
  geography = "county",
  measure = 140,
  release_year = 2024)

us_soc <- us_soc |> subset(select = -c(numerator,denominator,ci_low,ci_high))
            
us_soc_avg <- data.frame(
  Geo = c("United States"),
  raw_value = c(mean(us_soc$raw_value, na.rm = TRUE)))

ne_soc <- get_chrr_measure_data(
  geography = "state",
  measure = 140,
  release_year = 2024
) |> filter(state_fips %in%  c("25", "09", "23", "33", "50", "44")
            )|> subset(select = -c(numerator,denominator,ci_low,ci_high))

ne_soc$state_fips <- convert_fips_to_names(c("25", "09", "23", "33", "50", "44"))

ne_soc <- ne_soc %>% rename_at('state_fips', ~'Geo')
ne_soc$county_fips <- NULL 
ne_soc$fips <- NULL


county_soc <- get_chrr_measure_data(
  geography = "county",
  measure = 140,
  release_year = 2024
) |> filter(state_fips == "25") |> subset(
  select = -c(numerator,denominator,ci_low,ci_high))

county_soc$county_fips <- convert_fips_to_names(c("001", "003", "005", "007", "009", "011", "013","015","017","019","021","023","025","027"), states = c("MA"), geo_header = "COUNTY")

county_soc <- county_soc %>% rename_at('county_fips', ~'Geo')
county_soc$state_fips <- NULL 

scalar_soc <- bind_rows(county_soc, ne_soc, us_soc_avg)

scalar_soc$fips <- stringr::str_replace_all(scalar_soc$fips, "\\s+", "")
scalar_soc <- scalar_soc %>% rename_at('raw_value', ~'Social Associations')


```

#Literacy
```{r}
us_lr <- read_csv('ec data/LiteracyRates_Nation.csv') |> filter(grpName == 'all') |> subset(select = c(Country,Lit_A)) 

us_lr <- us_lr %>% rename_at('Country', ~'Geo')


ne_lr <- read_csv('ec data/LiteracyRates - State (1).csv') |> filter(grpName == 'all') |> subset(select = c(State,FIPS_code,Lit_A)) |> filter(FIPS_code %in% c("25", "09", "23", "33", "50", "44"))
#dr. c
                
  #("Massachusetts","Connecticut","Maine","New Hampshire","Vermont","Rhode Island"))

county_lr <- read_csv('ec data/LiteracyRates - County.csv') |> filter(grpName == 'all') |> filter(State == 'Massachusetts') |> subset(select = c(FIPS_code,County,Lit_A)) 

ne_lr <- ne_lr %>% rename_at('State', ~'Geo')
county_lr <- county_lr %>% rename_at('County', ~'Geo')


scalar_lr <- bind_rows(county_lr, ne_lr, us_lr)
scalar_lr$FIPS_code <- NULL
```

#Library Visits and Broadband
```{r}
county_lvbb <- read_csv('ec data/CivicIndex.csv') |> subset(select = c('Abbr','County','Percent of households with broadband','Library visits per 10,000 population'))

us_lvbb_avg <- data.frame(
  Geo = c("United States"),
  bb = c(mean(county_lvbb$'Percent of households with broadband', na.rm = TRUE)),
  lv = c(mean(county_lvbb$'Library visits per 10,000 population', na.rm = TRUE)))
  
ne_lvbb <- county_lvbb |> filter(Abbr %in%  c("MA","CT","ME","NH","VT","RI"))
ne_lvbb <- ne_lvbb %>% rename_at('Percent of households with broadband', ~'bb')
ne_lvbb <- ne_lvbb %>% rename_at('Library visits per 10,000 population', ~'lv')

ne_lvbb_avg <- data.frame(
  Geo = c("MA","CT","ME","NH","VT","RI"),
  bb = c((mean(ne_lvbb$bb[ne_lvbb$Abbr == 'MA'], na.rm = TRUE)),(mean(ne_lvbb$bb[ne_lvbb$Abbr == 'CT'], na.rm = TRUE)),(mean(ne_lvbb$bb[ne_lvbb$Abbr == 'ME'], na.rm = TRUE)),(mean(ne_lvbb$bb[ne_lvbb$Abbr == 'NH'], na.rm = TRUE)),(mean(ne_lvbb$bb[ne_lvbb$Abbr == 'VT'], na.rm = TRUE)),(mean(ne_lvbb$bb[ne_lvbb$Abbr == 'RI'], na.rm = TRUE))),
  lv = c((mean(ne_lvbb$lv[ne_lvbb$Abbr == 'MA'], na.rm = TRUE)),(mean(ne_lvbb$lv[ne_lvbb$Abbr == 'CT'], na.rm = TRUE)),(mean(ne_lvbb$lv[ne_lvbb$Abbr == 'ME'], na.rm = TRUE)),(mean(ne_lvbb$lv[ne_lvbb$Abbr == 'NH'], na.rm = TRUE)),(mean(ne_lvbb$lv[ne_lvbb$Abbr == 'VT'], na.rm = TRUE)),(mean(ne_lvbb$lv[ne_lvbb$Abbr == 'RI'], na.rm = TRUE))))

macty_lvbb <- county_lvbb |> filter(Abbr %in%  c("MA")) 
macty_lvbb <- macty_lvbb %>% rename_at('County', ~'Geo')
macty_lvbb <- macty_lvbb %>% rename_at('Percent of households with broadband', ~'bb')
macty_lvbb <- macty_lvbb %>% rename_at('Library visits per 10,000 population', ~'lv')

scalar_lvbb <- bind_rows(macty_lvbb, ne_lvbb_avg, us_lvbb_avg)
scalar_lvbb$Abbr <- NULL 

```
